title: Baa Juice Watermelon 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Baa Juice Watermelon Nic Salt captures the fresh sweetness of ripe Watermelon in a simple yet satisfying fruit profile. Light, juicy, and delicately sweet, it’s a flavour that feels refreshing without being overpowering — an easy all-day vape for fruit fans. Part of the Baa Juice Bar Salts range, this e-liquid is made with double-concentrated flavour to replicate the impactful taste of bar-style vapes. Blended at 50VG/50PG, it’s designed for Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) vaping, delivering clear flavour, discreet vapour, and a smooth throat hit. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, Baa Juice Watermelon Nic Salt is a straightforward fruit vape that pairs perfectly with refillable pod kits and starter devices.
